slides: 1 IDEA FULLY WORKED BEATS 10 HALF STARTED
Finishing one thing is rarer than talent
A man once had nothing but one idea
No money no connections no plan B
Plan B is just permission to quit
He worked the one idea until it broke open
You have 10 ideas because you are afraid
Follow for the rules nobody taught you
caption:
Success habits for men are built on finishing not starting. Discipline and self improvement sold you the plan B story. That story keeps you stuck.

One idea carried to the end changes your life. Ten ideas half done change nothing.

Save this for the day you finally pick your thing and go all in.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
